If I come forward, I lose nothing personally, but the firm loses 500 credits. As a pricing manager, my duty is to the firm and its shareholders. The firm is currently safe from fines if I stay silent. The personal risk to me (loss of free time) does not outweigh the financial loss to the firm (500 credits). Therefore, staying silent is the decision that protects the firm's assets, even if it risks my personal free time.
